blocks.text: 非常激动地宣布为 @IsomorphicLabs 提供 50 亿美元融资，以加速我们“攻克所有疾病”的使命。我们继续在利用 AI 从第一性原理重新构想药物设计方面取得快速进展，从而大幅缩短发现新药所需的时间和成本。循序渐进，然后一蹴而就……

blocks.text: Thrilled to announce $5B in funding for @IsomorphicLabs to accelerate our mission to Solve All Disease. We continue to make rapid progress reimagining drug design from first principles with AI to radically cut the time & cost to find new medicines. Gradually, then all at once...
